review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — keyword-borderline.test.ts's first test asserts observability is in borderline and that decidedOut is ['observability'] for a 'metrics' description. decidedOut is only populated for sectors with no non-keyword score.
- A2: met — The second and third tests assert the route is approved without asking, both freshly routed and resumed from the ledger, and that the ledger contains 'decided not in: observability (scored only on description keywords)'.
- A3: met — Tests cover a skill path trigger (src/styles/**), a skill keyword trigger (typography) and IaC (infra/main.tf), and each still holds the route with the borderline reason.
- A4: met — The only change to task.test.ts is in the named test: draft(ann) is replaced by runTaskNew with a card that touches src/styles/**. The assertions below it are untouched.

<details><summary>2 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- decidedOut and KEYWORD_ONLY_REASON lack the doc comments their neighbours carry `packages/runtime/src/router/route.ts:110` — Add a comment such as /** Borderline sectors that scored only on description keywords: decided not in, so they don't hold the route. */ and a short one on KEYWORD_ONLY_REASON.
- The ledger line format is duplicated between writer and parser `packages/runtime/src/task/autonomy.ts:72` — Export a small formatter and pattern, for example decidedOutLine(sector) and DECIDED_OUT, from one module and use them on both sides.

</details>

_Not reviewed: `packages/action/dist/SOURCE_SHA256` (generated), `packages/action/dist/index.js` (generated)._

suggestions.title: decidedOut and KEYWORD_ONLY_REASON lack the doc comments their neighbours carry
suggestions.detail: Every other Routing field and exported constant nearby has a one-line /** */ comment explaining why it exists. decidedOut (line 110) and KEYWORD_ONLY_REASON (line 43) have none, which falls short of the house rule to match the file's comment density.
suggestions.repro: Read Routing: borderline has 'Sectors that scored under the threshold: the human decides.', but decidedOut has no comment.
suggestions.fix: Add a comment such as /** Borderline sectors that scored only on description keywords: decided not in, so they don't hold the route. */ and a short one on KEYWORD_ONLY_REASON.

suggestions.title: The ledger line format is duplicated between writer and parser
suggestions.detail: task-route.ts writes `decided not in: ${sector} (${KEYWORD_ONLY_REASON})`, and autonomy.ts parses it with a separate hand-written regex. If either side changes the wording, resumed routes start holding again with no error.
suggestions.repro: Change the prefix in task-route.ts. borderlineOf then stops matching, and keyword-only sectors hold resumed routes again.
suggestions.fix: Export a small formatter and pattern, for example decidedOutLine(sector) and DECIDED_OUT, from one module and use them on both sides.

acceptance.note: keyword-borderline.test.ts's first test asserts observability is in borderline and that decidedOut is ['observability'] for a 'metrics' description. decidedOut is only populated for sectors with no non-keyword score.

The second and third tests assert the route is approved without asking, both freshly routed and resumed from the ledger, and that the ledger contains 'decided not in: observability (scored only on description keywords)'.
Tests cover a skill path trigger (src/styles/**), a skill keyword trigger (typography) and IaC (infra/main.tf), and each still holds the route with the borderline reason.
The only change to task.test.ts is in the named test: draft(ann) is replaced by runTaskNew with a card that touches src/styles/**. The assertions below it are untouched.
